chapters.title: Chapter One: The Missing Piece ......................................................... 1 In which Riley discovers a burned book in the library basement and accidentally erases her best friend from existence

Chapter Two: Empty Chairs ................................................................ 8 In which Riley realizes no one remembers Eli, and she meets Marcus Webb, a boy who notices things others forget
Chapter Three: The Hunger in the Pages .......................................... 16 In which Riley experiments with small spells and discovers that the book wants more than she's willing to give
Chapter Four: The Mentor's Warning ................................................ 24 In which Riley meets Evelyn Marsh, a former spellwright who has forgotten most of herself
Chapter Five: Small Victories ............................................................. 32 In which Riley uses magic to ace a test and accidentally erases her mother from her own graduation
Chapter Six: The Unwritten ............................................................... 40 In which Riley encounters the hollow shells of people who have traded away too much
Chapter Seven: The Rival .................................................................. 48 In which Riley meets Adrian Blackwood and the Revisionists, who believe suffering is optional
Chapter Eight: Memory Vault ............................................................. 56 In which Riley joins a collaborative spell to help her mother, with devastating consequences
Chapter Nine: The Friend's Gambit ................................................... 64 In which Marcus reveals his documentation project and offers Riley a chance to reclaim her stolen life

Chapter Ten: The First Temptation ................................................... 72 In which Riley and Marcus discover a library of burned books and Riley brings back something that shouldn't exist

Chapter Eleven: The Weight of Silence ............................................ 80 In which Riley wakes up with no memory of who she is, guided by a friend she can't remember and another she shouldn't trust
Chapter Twelve: Breaking Points ....................................................... 88 In which Riley reads Marcus's documentation of her life and struggles to understand what she's lost
Chapter Thirteen: The Rival's Truth .................................................. 96 In which Adrian reveals his own painful history and the true scope of the magical threat
Chapter Fourteen: The Mentor's Last Lesson ................................. 104 In which Evelyn explains the creature beneath the town and the terrible choice that must be made
Chapter Fifteen: The Original Codex .............................................. 112 In which the source of all spellbooks awakens and offers humanity a final chance at perfection

Chapter Sixteen: Memory Palace ..................................................... 120 In which Riley helps former victims rebuild their lives and learns that recovery is possible even after losing everything
Chapter Seventeen: The Weight of Remembering .......................... 128 In which new threats emerge and Riley realizes the magical crisis is far from over
Chapter Eighteen: The Rival's Sacrifice .......................................... 136 In which Adrian faces his family's legacy and makes the ultimate choice between existence and responsibility
Chapter Nineteen: The Final Scar .................................................... 144 In which the community mourns Adrian's sacrifice and commits to continuing the work of healing

Chapter Twenty: Epilogue - What Was Lost, What Was Found ....... 152 In which Riley, one year later, has built a treatment center for magical trauma and faces the reality that the story is far from over
